shots.voice: You just pooped in the forest
shots.scene: Medium close-up. YOU peeking out from behind the thick trunk of a big pine tree: only his head, shoulders and one hand on the bark are visible, the rest of him is hidden behind the trunk. Eyes half closed, a calm relieved little smile, cheeks a bit pink. Warm sunset light on his face, blurred pine forest behind him. His face is a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Hook: green wavy stink lines rise from behind the tree. Slow push-in, quick punch-in on "pooped".
shots.sound: Forest birds ambience from the first frame.

shots.scene: Wide shot. One big pine tree stands in the middle of a thick pine forest at sunset. YOU's head with messy hair and the red hoodie peeks out from the side of its trunk, small in the frame. Ferns and round bushes around the base of the tree. A small orange camping tent far in the background between the trees. Golden light rays between the trunks.
shots.effect: Small green stink lines above the tree. Slow sideways pan.

shots.scene: Close-up of YOU's hand holding up an empty cardboard toilet paper tube (just the brown cardboard roll, no paper left), in the center of the image. Behind it, out of focus, YOU's face peeks from behind the tree, staring at the empty tube with a blank, disappointed face. Warm sunset light.
shots.effect: Punch-in on "paper". One sweat drop.

shots.scene: Close-up of a GIANT green leaf growing on a forest bush, bigger than a person's head, covered in tiny fuzzy hairs, with pixel-texture veins. YOU's hand in a red hoodie sleeve reaches in from the right and grabs the leaf by its edge. Sunset light glowing through the leaf, blurred pine trees behind.
shots.effect: Slow push-in on the giant leaf.

shots.scene: Medium shot. YOU standing behind a big round bush that hides him from the waist down. He freezes with an uncomfortable face: eyes wide, mouth a tight wobbly line, one eyebrow twitching, shoulders pulled up. Pine forest at sunset behind him. His face is a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Red cartoon itch squiggles pop around him. Tiny shake.

shots.scene: Medium shot. YOU behind the same big round bush (it hides him from the waist down), scratching wildly behind his back with both hands, elbows out, eyes squeezed shut, tongue sticking out, hair even messier. Leaves flying off the bush around him. Pine forest at sunset behind him.
shots.effect: Strong shake, fast zoom pulses with every scratch.
shots.kling: He scratches behind his back like crazy: very fast frantic arm movements, body wiggling, leaves flying off the bush. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up at ground level. The BEAR's huge furry brown paw with big dark claws steps on a dry branch on the mossy forest floor; the branch snaps in two, small wood splinters flying. Pine needles and moss around it, dark trees blurred behind, low orange sunset light.
shots.effect: Punch-in + shake on "snaps". After the snap ALL sound cuts out.

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of YOU's face peeking over the top of the bush, frozen in shock: eyes stretched very wide with tiny pupils, eyebrows high, mouth a small straight line, one sweat drop on his forehead. Dark forest behind him, cold shadow on half of his face. His eyes are a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Slow zoom into his wide eyes, colours slightly drained. Total silence.

shots.scene: Wide shot looking deep into the forest. Dark shadowy pine trunks, bushes shaking, and a huge dark silhouette moving between the trees in the distance with two small shiny eyes. A few small birds fly off a branch. Last orange sunset light at the edges, cold blue shadows in the middle.
shots.effect: Slow push into the dark trees.

shots.scene: Low-angle shot. The giant BEAR walks out of the dark trees into the warm sunset light, coming toward the camera: huge and heavy, head low, small black eyes, big wet shiny nose. Dark pine trunks behind it, golden rim light on its fur, dust and pine needles around its paws.
shots.effect: Slow dramatic zoom in.
shots.kling: The huge bear slowly walks out of the dark trees toward the camera, heavy steps, head swaying, fur moving. Slow dramatic camera push-in. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Extreme low-angle shot from the ground. The BEAR stands up on its hind legs, enormous, as tall as the pine trees, towering over a small orange camping tent next to its feet (the tent looks tiny). Its head is near the top of the image against the orange sunset sky, front paws raised.
shots.effect: Slow tilt up from the tent to the bear's head.

shots.scene: Medium shot. The BEAR on all fours in a forest clearing, frozen mid-step with one front paw lifted in the air, ears up, head raised, alert. Pine trees and bushes around it, golden sunset light.
shots.effect: Quick punch-in on "stops".

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of the BEAR's big wet shiny black nose, filling most of the image, nostrils wide open, tiny shiny water droplets on it, brown pixel fur of the snout and whiskers around it. Warm sunset light, blurred forest behind.
shots.effect: Small zoom pulse on every sniff, little air swirls going into the nose.
shots.kling: The bear's wet nose sniffs the air: nostrils flare open and shut quickly, nose twitching up and down. Camera static, very close. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.voice: Then it walks straight toward you
shots.scene: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind YOU: the back of his messy dark hair and red hood in the bottom-left corner, hiding behind a bush. In the middle of the image, the BEAR walks straight toward the camera on all fours, big and heavy, looking right at him. Pine forest at sunset.
shots.effect: Slow push-in toward the bear.

shots.scene: Medium close-up. YOU crouching behind the bush, only his head and shoulders above the leaves, panicking: eyes wide, mouth open in a silent scream, looking sideways, big sweat drops flying off his head. Pine forest at sunset behind him. His face is a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Sweat drops flying, small shake.

shots.scene: Close-up. YOU behind the bush looking straight into the camera with a flat, embarrassed, deadpan face: half-closed eyes, mouth a straight line, pink blushing cheeks, one sweat drop. Leaves of the bush at the bottom of the image. His face is a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Hard punch-in on "done".

shots.scene: Extreme close-up. YOU holding his breath: cheeks puffed out like two balloons, lips pressed tight, eyes squeezed shut, face turning red, sweat drops on his forehead. Leaves around his face. His face is a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Slow zoom in, cheeks wobble, face gets redder during the long pause.

shots.scene: Calm, wide, high shot over the pine forest at sunset, like a nature documentary: tall pine treetops, golden light rays, soft haze, a small river in the distance. Peaceful. No characters.
shots.effect: Calm slow push-in (the twist starts).

shots.voice: bears can smell about seven times
shots.scene: The BEAR and a BLOODHOUND sitting side by side in a forest clearing, both facing the camera like a size comparison. The bear is huge, on the left, with a big wet shiny nose; the bloodhound is small, on the right, with long droopy ears and a wrinkly face. Soft sunset forest background. Empty space above the bear's head.
shots.effect: A big "x7" sign (pixel font) pops in next to the bear's nose on "seven".

shots.scene: Close-up of the BLOODHOUND looking up at something huge above it: long droopy ears, wrinkly face, sad humbled eyes, one sweat drop, its small nose. Behind it, out of focus, the big brown furry body of the BEAR. Forest at sunset.
shots.effect: Slow push-in on the sad dog.

shots.voice: It smelled you from miles away
shots.scene: Top-down view from very high above a huge pine forest at sunset, like a game map: endless low-poly pine treetops, a winding river, small hills and clearings. At the bottom of the image, one small tree with a tiny guy in a red hoodie hiding behind it. At the top of the image, far away, the BEAR's head sticks out of the trees, nose pointing toward him. A long empty winding path between them.
shots.effect: Animated green wavy stink trail travels for miles from his tree to the bear's nose; the camera follows it up.
shots.sound: Long whoosh, then a sniff at the end.

shots.scene: View from behind the bush where YOU hides, big leaves in the foreground at the bottom. The BEAR is now very close, filling the middle of the image, walking toward the camera with its big head lowered, sniffing. Pine forest at sunset behind it, long shadows.
shots.effect: Slow push-in, small stink lines rising from the bush.

shots.scene: Low-angle shot looking straight up from behind the bush: the BEAR's huge face leans over the top of the bush and looks down into the camera, big wet nose very close, small black eyes, its shadow covering everything. Orange sky and pine treetops behind its head.
shots.effect: Hard punch-in + small shake on "Closer".

shots.scene: Extreme close-up of the BEAR's face from the side as it takes one big sniff: eyes closed, nose up, nostrils wide open, cheeks pulled in. Sunset light, blurred forest behind.
shots.effect: Green stink lines get sucked into its nose, then a short freeze.

shots.scene: Close-up of the BEAR's face, front view: its small black eyes filling up with big shiny tears, tears starting to run down its furry cheeks, sad eyebrows, mouth trembling. Its face has a slight green tint. Forest at sunset behind. Its eyes are a little above the middle of the image.
shots.effect: Cartoon tears well up and drip. Green fog starts creeping in.

shots.scene: Medium close-up. The BEAR sitting back and pinching its nose shut with one big paw, eyes squeezed shut with tears, cheeks puffed, face slightly green, disgusted. Light green haze in the air around it. Pine forest at sunset.
shots.effect: Green fog, small shake.
shots.kling: The bear keeps pinching its nose with its paw, squeezes its eyes shut and shakes its head in disgust, tears dripping. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: The BEAR running away through the pine forest on its hind legs, seen from the side, arms flailing up, mouth wide open, crying hard with big blue cartoon tears streaming and flying back from its eyes, dust cloud behind its feet. Golden sunset light between the trees.
shots.effect: Big blue tears flying, fast pan with the bear.
shots.sound: Bear crying / wailing, footsteps running away.
shots.kling: The bear runs away fast on its hind legs, arms flailing, crying with its mouth wide open, big blue tears flying behind it. Camera pans to follow it. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Wide shot of pine treetops against an orange sunset sky: a huge flock of small dark birds bursts out of the trees all at once, flying up and away. On a branch in front, a small red squirrel runs along with them. Leaves and pine needles falling.
shots.effect: Birds burst out, small shake.
shots.sound: Birds flying away (lots of wing flaps), squirrel squeak.
shots.kling: A huge flock of birds bursts out of the treetops all at once and flies away into the sky; the squirrel runs along the branch and jumps away. Camera static. Keep the low-poly style.

shots.scene: Wide shot of the quiet, empty pine forest at sunset: tall pine trees, one big pine tree in front, the small orange camping tent alone in a clearing, long shadows, pink-orange sky above the treetops. Peaceful and empty: no people, no animals, no birds.
shots.effect: Ending like the plane: green stink lines rising over the trees, green haze, slow zoom out.
shots.sound: Quiet forest, no birds. One last cricket.
